title: Naya stock aaya. *Purane customers* ko kaise bataoge?
fix_label: Size ke hisaab se ye bhejo 👇
message:

why: pichli kharidari yaad dilao, *unka size*, kam stock, aur 24 ghante hold. Spam nahi, personal.
caption:
